metadata.name: mandate
metadata.description: Mandate: enforceable designated-market-maker contracts on Solana

instructions.name: accept_mandate
docs: Market maker accepts the terms and posts the bond.

accounts.name: fee_vault
docs: Must already hold every fee the maker could earn over the term.

instructions.name: add_liquidity
docs: Maker deploys vault inventory into the position, within the reference band.

instructions.name: cancel
docs: Issuer cancels before any maker accepts; all funds are returned.

instructions.name: claim_maker_fees
docs: Maker claims fees earned for compliant periods.

instructions.name: close_position
docs: Close an empty position (maker while active; anyone after).

instructions.name: create_mandate
docs: Issuer creates and funds a mandate over a DLMM pair, referenced to a DAMM v2 pool.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Top up inventory or the fee budget.

instructions.name: finalize
docs: Permissionless: finalize elapsed periods, slash on breach, expire at term end.

instructions.name: init_router
docs: Launchpad creates its router (used as the DBC `leftover_receiver`).

instructions.name: open_position
docs: Maker opens the DLMM position owned by the mandate PDA.

instructions.name: recover_leftover
docs: Permissionless: once the mandate has ended, send leftover supply to its issuer.

instructions.name: register_launch
docs: Launchpad maps a launched mint to its mandate.

instructions.name: remove_liquidity
docs: Withdraw liquidity back into the vaults (maker while active; anyone after).
`bps = 0` with `claim_fees` only claims LP fees.

instructions.name: route_leftover
docs: Permissionless: move DBC leftover supply from the router into the mandate vault.

instructions.name: settle
docs: Permissionless: distribute all funds once breached/expired and unwound.

instructions.name: snapshot
docs: Permissionless: measure the maker's quotes and record compliance.

instructions.name: sweep
docs: Permissionless: return tokens that reached a settled or cancelled mandate's vaults.

accounts.name: bond_owner_quote
docs: Only the maker ever funds the bond vault, so anything there after settlement is
the maker's. A cancelled mandate never had a bond: it goes to the issuer.

errors.name: InvalidParams
errors.msg: Invalid mandate parameters

errors.name: InvalidStatus
errors.msg: Mandate is not in the required status

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer is not allowed to perform this action

errors.name: InvalidOwner
errors.msg: Account is not owned by the expected program

errors.name: InvalidAccountData
errors.msg: Account data is malformed or has the wrong discriminator

errors.name: PairMintMismatch
errors.msg: DLMM pair does not match the mandate base/quote mints (base must be token X)

errors.name: ReferenceMintMismatch
errors.msg: Reference pool does not match the mandate base/quote mints

errors.name: OutsideBand
errors.msg: Liquidity range is outside the allowed band around the reference price

errors.name: QuoteAboveReference
errors.msg: Quote may only be placed in bins at or below the reference price

errors.name: BaseBelowReference
errors.msg: Base may only be placed in bins at or above the reference price

errors.name: OracleMismatch
errors.msg: Oracle account does not match the DLMM pair

errors.name: FreezableBaseMint
errors.msg: Base mint has a freeze authority, which could freeze the mandate's vault

errors.name: RangeOutsidePosition
errors.msg: Liquidity range is outside the mandate position

errors.name: PositionAlreadyOpen
errors.msg: Mandate already has an open position

errors.name: NoPosition
errors.msg: Mandate has no open position

errors.name: PositionMismatch
errors.msg: Position account does not match the mandate

errors.name: MissingBinArray
errors.msg: A required bin array was not supplied

errors.name: NotActiveWindow
errors.msg: Mandate is not active at this time

errors.name: PositionNotEmpty
errors.msg: Position still holds liquidity

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: Math overflow

errors.name: InvalidTokenAccount
errors.msg: Token account does not match the expected vault or owner

errors.name: LaunchMismatch
errors.msg: Launch record does not match this mandate

errors.name: InsufficientVault
errors.msg: Insufficient vault balance

errors.name: LiquidityCooldown
errors.msg: Liquidity was added too recently to be removed

errors.name: UnderfundedFees
errors.msg: The fee vault must hold every fee the maker could earn before a maker can accept

fields.name: strategy_type
docs: DLMM StrategyType (0..=8), e.g. 3 = SpotBalanced, 6 = SpotImBalanced.

types.name: Anchor
docs: The mandate's reference price: a DLMM bin that follows the pair's oracle TWAP at a
bounded speed. See `anchor.rs`.

fields.name: bin
docs: Reference bin; its DLMM price is the mandate's reference price.

fields.name: target
docs: Latest TWAP bin the reference is moving toward.

fields.name: ts
docs: Accrual clock for the speed limit.

fields.name: taint_ts
docs: Oracle samples recorded before this time may include misattributed time.

fields.name: start_cum
docs: TWAP window start (a DLMM oracle sample).

fields.name: next_cum
docs: Candidate for the next window start.

fields.name: designated_maker
docs: Restrict acceptance to one maker; `Pubkey::default()` lets any maker accept.

types.name: LaunchRecord
docs: Maps a launched base mint to the mandate that receives its leftover supply.

types.name: MakerProfile
docs: Public track record of a market maker across all mandates.

fields.name: oracle
docs: The DLMM pair's oracle account (source of the TWAP).

fields.name: position
docs: DLMM position owned by this PDA (default when none is open).

fields.name: position_rent_payer
docs: Who paid rent for the position (refunded on close).

fields.name: last_liquidity_add_ts
docs: Last time the maker added liquidity; removals are blocked for
`liquidity_lock_secs` afterwards so liquidity cannot be added just for a
snapshot and pulled right after.

fields.name: anchor
docs: Reference price state.

fields.name: start_ts
docs: Scoring start: acceptance plus the setup window (`SETUP_GRACE_SECS`).

fields.name: current_period
docs: Period currently being observed (0-based, relative to `start_ts`).

fields.name: snapshots_total
docs: Total snapshots taken over the mandate's life.

types.name: MandateTerms
docs: Terms agreed between the issuer and the market maker. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: fee_per_period
docs: Quote paid to the maker for each compliant period.

fields.name: period_secs
docs: Length of a scoring period in seconds (e.g. 3600).

fields.name: duration_periods
docs: Number of periods the mandate runs once accepted.

fields.name: bond_amount
docs: Quote the maker must post as a performance bond.

fields.name: max_spread_bps
docs: Max quoted spread around the reference price, in bps, measured at a size of
`min_depth_quote / SPREAD_SIZE_DIVISOR` on each side.

fields.name: min_depth_quote
docs: Min committed liquidity (quote value) on each side within `depth_window_bps` of the reference.

fields.name: depth_window_bps
docs: Window around the reference price in which committed liquidity is counted, in bps.

fields.name: band_bps
docs: Mandated liquidity may only be placed in bins priced within ±band of the reference price.

fields.name: anchor_twap_secs
docs: Length of the DLMM oracle TWAP window the reference follows, in seconds.

fields.name: anchor_speed_bps_per_min
docs: Max speed at which the reference price may move toward the TWAP, in bps per minute.

fields.name: liquidity_lock_secs
docs: Liquidity added while active must stay deployed at least this long before removal.

fields.name: max_consecutive_failures
docs: Consecutive failed periods that trigger a slash.

fields.name: slash_bps
docs: Share of the bond transferred to the issuer on breach, in bps.

fields.name: spread_bps
docs: Quoted spread at size around the reference (u16::MAX when a side is missing).

fields.name: bid_depth_quote
docs: Committed liquidity (quote value) at or below the reference, within the window.

fields.name: ask_depth_quote
docs: Committed liquidity (quote value) above the reference, within the window.

fields.name: ref_deviation_bps
docs: Informational: reference price vs the DAMM v2 (graduation) pool price.

fields.name: status
docs: 0 = empty, 1 = ok, 2 = failed, 3 = unobserved

fields.name: status
docs: 1 ok, 2 failed, 3 unobserved

types.name: Router
docs: Launchpad router: set as the DBC config `leftover_receiver`, so unsold supply of every
token launched from that config lands in the router's ATAs and can be routed into the
token's mandate vault.

types.name: ScoreLog
docs: Ring buffer of finalized periods, read by dashboards.
